bundle_analysis_example.required_behavior: Use only Bundle records and declared quality/missing-information/provenance; do not treat missing values as zero or claim to have seen records outside the Bundle.
bundle_analysis_example.example_language: The Bundle contains 9 diet days and 5 training sessions; the missing three diet days limit any comparison, so this is an association in the available records rather than a causal conclusion.
